working_definition: Author cell type 'lamina intrinsic amacrine neuron Lai' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 368 cells): lamina intrinsic (amacrine) neurons Lai; no author FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Intrinsic amacrine neuron of the lamina with arborizations spanning the proximal and distal lamina, whose cell body lies proximal to the lamina (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Meinertzhagen and Sorra, 2001). Glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020).

justification: Same named type (Lai, lamina intrinsic amacrine neuron). FBbt term is a direct child of optic lobe amacrine neuron and adult optic lobe neuron; no separate adult variant is needed (term is adult-defined).
